title: Geo-Request Classification Engine and SLA-Aware Routing for Enterprise Onboarding
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Launch a classification + routing service that automatically triages enterprise region/residency requests into a prioritized intake queue and assigns an SLA-aware routing policy (e.g., local-region, cross-border with contractual exceptions, failover-only). The engine will consume customer intake forms, contract constraints, and operational capacity signals to recommend: priority bucket, target region(s), failover mapping, estimated provisioning lead time, and a minimal set of compliance controls required. This will reduce manual adjudication overhead for Sales/RevOps/Onboarding and improve time-to-provision for high-value customers.
background: Enterprise customers increasingly submit nuanced geo requests: combinations of data residency, processing-in-region, contractual jurisdiction exclusions, and multi-region failover requirements. Current triage is manual (Redis queues + spreadsheets) and inconsistent. That causes slow sales cycles and missed SLAs for Dedicated/Private plans.
proposed_solution: Build a lightweight rules engine (first iteration: deterministic heuristics + weighted scoring) with a small ML classifier later. Inputs: intake form fields, existing contract flags (MFA/contract repo), capacity inventory signal, and known regulated-region mappings. Output: recommended priority (P0/P1/P2), region(s), required controls (KMS, VPC peering), estimated lead time, and route-to-team (Sales-assist/Onboarding/Dedicated infra). Integrate with Zendesk/HubSpot webhook and Console provisioning runbook generator. Provide an admin UI in the Console for reviewers to override and log rationale.
acceptance_criteria: Classification service returns a recommendation for 95% of incoming enterprise geo requests in <= 3s.
Recommendations include: priority, target region(s), required controls, estimated lead time, and assigned handler team.
Integration created to ingest intake form via POST and emit a Linear ticket draft with populated fields.
Admin UI allows reviewer to accept/override, with audit trail stored in the Console's event log.
Metrics dashboard surfaces triage throughput, override rate, mean time to decision, and lead time to provision.
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (MVP, 4 weeks): deterministic rules engine, webhook intake, Linear ticket draft, basic admin overrides.
Phase 2 (8 weeks): capacity signal integration, SLA-aware routing policies, Console admin UI, monitoring dashboards.
Phase 3 (Q3): ML-assisted prioritization, A/B tune scoring weights, automated provisioning hooks for low-risk requests.
metrics: Reduction in manual adjudication time: >= 60% for Sales
risks: Incorrect classification could route a request to the wrong region and violate contract—mitigate by requiring reviewer sign-off for high-risk flags.
Incomplete capacity data may return optimistic lead times—build conservative fallbacks and TTL on capacity cache.
Legal/regulatory edge cases need fast escalation path to Compliance to avoid delays.
